pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc_stats AS (SELECT district, 100.0 * NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS anc_pct FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023), livelihood_stats AS (SELECT district, 100.0 * NULLIF(employed_at_6_months, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS livelihood_pct FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district, a.anc_pct, l.livelihood_pct FROM anc_stats AS a FULL OUTER JOIN livelihood_stats AS l ON a.district = l.district

WITH anc_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    100.0 * NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS anc_pct
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE year = 2023
),
livelihood_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    100.0 * NULLIF(employed_at_6_months, 0) / NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0) AS livelihood_pct
  FROM livelihoods
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district,
  a.anc_pct,
  l.livelihood_pct
FROM anc_stats a
FULL OUTER JOIN livelihood_stats l ON a.district = l.district;
